cure.definition:
v. prepare by drying, salting, or chemical processing in order to preserve
v. make (substances) hard and improve their usability
v. be or become preserved
cure.translation:
n. 治疗, 治愈, 治疗法
vt. 治疗, 治愈, 改正, 腌制, 加工处理, 使硫化
vi. 受治疗, 被加工处理, 被硫化

cure accelerator.translation: [化] 促进剂; 硫化促进剂

cure sb of sth.translation: 治愈(某人)的(病), 纠正(某人)的(坏习惯)

cure-all.definition: n hypothetical remedy for all ills or diseases; once sought by the alchemists

cure-alls.definition: n. hypothetical remedy for all ills or diseases; once sought by the alchemists
cure-alls.translation: n. 万灵药( cure-all的复数形式 )

cured.definition:
s. freed from illness or injury
s. (used of rubber) treated by a chemical or physical process to improve its properties (hardness and strength and odor and elasticity)
s. (used of concrete or mortar) kept moist to assist the hardening
cured.translation: a. 治愈的；熟化的；熏制的

cured natural rubber.translation: [化] 天然硫化胶; 天然胶的硫化胶

cured resin.translation: [化] 凝固树脂; 硬树脂

cureless.translation: a. 医不好的, 无法医治的, 无法矫正的

curer.definition:
n. One who cures; a healer; a physician.
n. One who prepares beef, fish, etc., for preservation by
   drying, salting, smoking, etc.

curers.definition:
plural of curer
n. One who cures; a healer; a physician.
n. One who prepares beef, fish, etc., for preservation by
   drying, salting, smoking, etc.
curers.translation: (curer 的复数) 治疗者, 治疗器

cures.definition:
n a medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain
v provide a cure for, make healthy again
v prepare by drying, salting, or chemical processing in order to preserve
v make (substances) hard and improve their usability
v be or become preserved
cures.translation: n. 治愈；治疗法（cure的复数形式）

curet.definition: n a surgical instrument shaped like a scoop to remove tissue from a bodily cavity
curet.translation:
n. 刮器, 刮匙
vt. 用刮器刮

curettage.definition: n. surgery to remove tissue or growths from a bodily cavity (as the uterus) by scraping with a curette
curettage.translation:
n. 刮术, 刮除术
[医] 刮除术

curette.definition: n. a surgical instrument shaped like a scoop to remove tissue from a bodily cavity
curette.translation:
n. 刮匙, 刮器
vt. 用刮匙刮

curettement.definition: n surgery to remove tissue or growths from a bodily cavity (as the uterus) by scraping with a curette

curetting.translation:
n. [医] 刮匙；耳挖
vt. 用刮匙刮
n. (Curet)人名；(法)屈雷

curettings.translation:
(curetting 的复数) n. [医] 刮匙；耳挖
vt. 用刮匙刮
n. (Curet)人名；(法)屈雷
